integrity: The finite cell orbit construction, orientation conventions, cancellation trace, and independent homology check are fully specified and reproduced by supplied code. No claim of authorship, externally certified priority, or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A complete homotopy computation for the ordinary C7 quotient of the finite M(K7), not a theorem about arbitrary complete graphs. An unindexed equivalent source remains possible. The 2026 Wang–Li full text was not obtained, so its possible overlap is a residual risk.
title: The seven-cycle quotient of the seven-point matching complex
